manifest.matching_method: Unique normalized title + canonical region + canonical PAP node ID (FAP uses program and zone), one-to-one exact candidates. Amount does not determine identity. Duplicate keys remain ambiguous. Remaining House rows receive up to three fuzzy suggestions within the same region/PAP/zone, top-20 token-overlap shortlist (ties ordered by source ID), then SequenceMatcher >=0.85; suggestions do not consume NEP rows. No pair has been manually certified.
